stories.title: Macklemore says "Free Palestine" at an Ed Sheeran stadium show
stories.summary: Opening for Ed Sheeran's Loop tour, Macklemore told a packed stadium "Free Palestine", then repeated "I said Free Palestine." After P!nk reshared a pro-Israel group's post demanding he apologize, he posted the clip with "Wanting all humans to be treated equal should never be controversial." It got 285K likes and 17K replies.
